decision.explanation: The source documents explicitly state that Rudi Zapf received two distinct awards. Document 1 (D1S2, D1S5, etc.) confirms he was awarded the 'Bayerischer Poetentaler' for his literary achievements. Document 2 (D2S1, D2S2, etc.) confirms he was awarded the 'AAAI Fellow' title for his contributions to AI and music. Both are valid answers to the question 'Which award did Rudi Zapf receive?'. Candidate C2 ('cash prize') is rejected as it is a component of the award ceremony, not the name of the award itself.
